authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Previously reviewed comparative evidence: CDIAL 10636 explicitly separates the -ḍ- extension, with Western Pahari rāmṛā/ramṛo and Nepali rāmro “beautiful, good”. Jambu’s *ramyaḍ- node selects that extension rather than bare ramya; borrowing into other Nepal-area languages needs independent evidence. Updated disposition under the user’s explicit cross-Indo-Aryan policy: link this supported etymon despite unresolved inheritance versus intra-Indo-Aryan borrowing. The reflex edge records etymological family affiliation provisionally; it does not establish uninterrupted inheritance or an immediate donor. Prior hold: The rāmro good-family is directly attested in Nepali; determine borrowing versus local inheritance in this other Nepal-area language.
